display.title: Episode 458: The Tall Chanukah Candles (Zos Chanukah)
display.summary_short: On the night all eight candles are lit, Uncle Yossi teaches what the menorah whispers about Moshiach's clouds; a first-grade class sings about chesed; and a Chassid's tall candles save his life.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on the night when all eight Chanukah lights are kindled. Uncle Yossi recalls the Rebbe's teaching, in the name of the Frierdiker Rebbe, that we must listen to what the candles tell us: a message of emunah and bitachon in Hashem, the King of miracles. Daniel HaNavi foretells the 'clouds of heaven' that will carry the Jewish people back to Eretz Yisroel when Moshiach gathers them together, and all eight candles shining at once are a sign of that unity. After the Hakochainik march, a first-grade class from Beis Yaakov of Boro Park, chosen from the coupons mailed in, recites the Shema and sings songs about chesed and hachnasas orchim learned from Avraham Avinu, and everyone gives tzedakah. In the Chanukah story, joyful Naftali explains why he dances on Chanukah: his Rebbe told him to buy Chanukah candles three feet tall, and when robbers stopped him on the road, the tall flames he lit were seen by distant fire-watchers, whose approach scared the robbers away. The show ends with a reminder about Chanukah mission cards and candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: Listen to the message of the Chanukah lights: trust in Hashem, the King of miracles, who will bring Moshiach and gather all of us home.
